evaluation.claim_scope: Controlled synthetic lab only; no CERT benchmark or production-accuracy claim.

baseline.updates: Past observed days, including prior anomalies, enter history; labels never filter history.

model.weights_status: Predeclared demo engineering parameters, not learned probabilities.

rules.actor_metric_definition: An actor is detected only by an alert on that actor's labeled malicious day; alerts on benign days never count as hits.

isolation_forest.actor_metric_definition: An actor is detected only by an alert on that actor's labeled malicious day; alerts on benign days never count as hits.

combined.actor_metric_definition: An actor is detected only by an alert on that actor's labeled malicious day; alerts on benign days never count as hits.

limits: No real employees or live enterprise data are represented.
A daily model does not score a partial current day.
A dataset label describes a scenario, not an inferred human intent.
Low support and distribution shift require a separate pilot.
An alert-budget threshold controls candidate triage, never hard DLP enforcement.
